name: OpenAI-compatible
summary: Any provider or server that speaks OpenAI's Chat Completions API: Moonshot Kimi, xAI Grok, OpenRouter, a LiteLLM gateway, or a self-hosted vLLM, Ollama or LM Studio server.

capabilities.trigger_rule: A model call an agent makes through its route: a person's question to the assistant, or a run of a scheduled agent the Owner enabled. AI proposes; it never writes the books.

preset.title: Preset
preset.description: The provider or server the connection starts from; its base URL, unless the connection names one.

base_url.title: Base URL
base_url.description: The endpoint's base, ending before /chat/completions; a self-hosted server is a registered private endpoint.

auth.title: Authentication
auth.description: An API key, or none for a self-hosted server on a registered private endpoint.

proven.title: Proved capabilities
proven.description: What the connection's probe proved its endpoint serves; set by the probe, never typed (AI-71).

timeout_seconds.title: Timeout
timeout_seconds.description: Seconds a call may take before it fails over or stops.

retries.title: Retries
retries.description: Retries of a call the provider refused as overloaded or rate limited, with backoff.

secrets.name: api_key
secrets.title: API key
secrets.description: The provider's or gateway's API key; a self-hosted server on a private endpoint may need none.

health_check: Counts the provider's refusals, rate limits and failed connections in recent calls, and the model list's last read.
test_action: Lists the connection's models, then asks the picked model a few tokens of synthetic text and reports what it answered with: its model, its usage and the capabilities it proved.
local_substitute: Recorded answers by default; a fake Chat Completions server in tests; a developer may point a local connection at their own Ollama or LM Studio.
